description: This machine's record of how a site's operations have been doing, from local files only (nothing is sent): a cool-down, stale marks, the tier calls start at beside the op's own, the last heal and verify, writes of the last 24 h, and calls of the last 24 h and 7 days (count, ok rate, tiers, median ms). storage says whether session and capture files are sealed here. problems lists what needs a step, each with its next. Without site: every site with something on record. Use it when calls got slow or keep failing.
name: site_status
